title: MILO Marathon 2026 Cagayan de Oro Leg Review: Mindanao's Proven Big Race
seo_title: MILO Marathon Cagayan de Oro 2026 Review | Philippines
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Cagayan de Oro Leg review: August 23 at Centrio Mall -- a leg that drew 9,300+ runners in 2023 and hosted the 2024 National Finals.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at Centrio Mall, this Cagayan de Oro leg of the 50th-anniversary MILO Marathon has a genuine track record -- 9,300+ runners in 2023, and the city hosted the National Finals for the first time in Mindanao in 2024 with over 12,600 participants.
verdict: Of all the 2026 MILO Marathon legs, Cagayan de Oro has the strongest recent track record on file. The 2023 edition drew over 9,300 runners and was the first marathon to run along the city's newly opened boulevard; 2024 saw Cagayan de Oro host the National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, pulling more than 12,600 participants and introducing a 42K category with a course running to Tagoloan town. That's a genuine growth trajectory, not just marketing copy. Five distances from 1K to 21.1K keep the 2026 leg itself accessible, with Centrio Mall as an anchor venue offering the parking and shelter that community races benefit from.

sections.heading: A Leg With Real Recent History
paragraphs: Unlike many of the newer 2026 additions to the MILO Marathon calendar, Cagayan de Oro has a documented recent track record. The 2023 leg drew over 9,300 runners across 21K, 10K, 5K and 3K categories, and was notable as the first marathon to run along the city's newly opened boulevard. [1] Milo Sports head Carlo Sampan called it "the city's biggest race and the first marathon to run in the newly opened boulevard, which makes this leg more special for the Kagay-anons." [1]

sections.heading: 2024: Mindanao's First National Finals
paragraphs: In 2024, Cagayan de Oro hosted the MILO Marathon National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, drawing over 12,600 participants -- and for the first time, the city ran a full 42K category, with the course extending from Velez Street to Tagoloan town in Misamis Oriental. [2] That's a significant marker of trust from national organisers in the city's ability to handle the marathon's biggest annual event.

sections.heading: Five Distances at Centrio Mall
paragraphs: The 2026 leg starts from Centrio Mall on Corrales Avenue and offers five categories: 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K half marathon. [3] Registration is currently open. A mall-anchored start/finish means built-in parking, shelter and post-race amenities -- practical advantages for a community race with a genuinely large field.

sections.heading: Community Buzz and Livestream Reach
paragraphs: The city has previously hosted City Hall carbo-loading dinners for qualifiers ahead of race day, and MILO has livestreamed the event on social media, drawing large national viewership when Cagayan de Oro hosted the Finals. [2] 2024 Milo Marathon Queen Christine Hallasgo, reflecting on her win, said: "This win is not just for me, but for everyone who believes in the power of hard work and perseverance." [2]

sections.heading: Part of MILO's 50th-Anniversary Golden Run
paragraphs: The 2026 edition is one of 15 legs in the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary 'Golden Run' series, organised by RUNRIO Inc. with local partners ahead of the National Finals in Clark City, Pampanga. [3] Given Cagayan de Oro's 2024 hosting turn and strong 2023 numbers, this leg carries more organisational weight than a typical provincial stop on the calendar.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a MILO Marathon leg with a proven recent history of strong turnout and serious organisational investment -- rather than a first-year unknown -- Cagayan de Oro on 23 August 2026 is one of the stronger picks on the 2026 calendar, and registration is already open. The five-distance spread makes it approachable whether you're running your first 5K or targeting the half marathon.

faqs.question: When and where is the MILO Marathon 2026 Cagayan de Oro Leg?
faqs.answer: 23 August 2026, starting at Centrio Mall on Corrales Avenue, Cagayan de Oro City. Five distances are offered: 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K half marathon, and registration is currently open. [3]

faqs.question: Has this leg run before?
faqs.answer: Yes, repeatedly. The 2023 edition drew over 9,300 runners, and in 2024 Cagayan de Oro hosted the MILO Marathon National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, with over 12,600 participants and a first-ever 42K category in the city. [1][2]

faqs.question: Is this a beginner-friendly race?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the five-category spread from 1K to 21.1K makes it accessible for first-time racers and families as well as half-marathon runners. It's part of the MILO Marathon's 50th-anniversary 'Golden Run' series of 15 legs nationwide, organised by RUNRIO Inc. [3]
